iota: He remembered Maggie as being anything but yielding in their earlier days, and she had never apparently changed one iota in her resentment toward her husband.
She was growing a little stout, but it did not seem to detract an iota from the grace of every step, pose, gesture.
But I shall not therefore drop one iota of my convictions, or cease to identify myself with that truth which an evil generation hates.
